rv.q: First Date goes for it. And it works.
First Date imbues a fun and familiar dating dilemma with new energy and creativity that sets it apart from other too-obvious romcom bores.
Anyone who has ever been "fixed-up" for a date will get a kick out of watching this 100 minute ( no intermission) musical comedy that employs a cast of five plus a piano player.

cn.t: Critics find this sweet rom-com delivers genuine laughs and embraces the cringe of modern dating, with the intimate Oil Lamp Theater proving an ideal fit for the show's bubbly energy and relatable awkwardness.
